# Waller V1.0.10

## New
- Per-image Home Screen Widget: add any wallpaper as its own widget and it opens straight to that image (#81)
- Carousel service status indicator in Settings (#80)
- In-app update notifications — you're alerted when an update is available, with release notes shown before downloading (#78)
- Version-numbered APK downloads: release APKs are named `waller-v1.0.10.apk`, and the in-app updater fetches the exact asset for its own version (#51)

## Improvements
- Faster image previews — removed side-by-side preload and the loading GIF so high-res wallpapers appear immediately (#76)
- Redesigned Info modal and Stats screen with human-readable sizes and accurate values, even on a fresh install
- Quicker app start, no black/loading screen
- Clearer fullscreen icon on the preview screen
- Home screen widget DB now uses a rollback journal to reduce lock contention
- Smaller Android footprint (no plyer on Android builds)

## Fixes
- Home screen widget reverting to its placeholder (SQLite busy/lock contention)
- Widget opening the wrong image or gallery position
- Missing wallpapers after clearing the app config
- "Thumbs" folder showing up as an image in the gallery
- Button shadow artifact at the bottom of some screens
- Widget stability and error handling improvements
